notes: First release of this fork. Multiple Claude accounts: Accounts page, tray account switcher, background sign-in renewal and re-login warnings. Weekly-only display for plans without a 5-hour limit, and Fable weekly usage everywhere usage shows. Live session tracking from Claude Code's own session registry (state and name of every open session) driving the desktop Buddy and the Clawdmeter. Clawdmeter gadget protocol 2: per-session state and context use, all accounts. Optional naming gate (asks unnamed Claude Code terminal sessions for /rename). Much faster startup; English by default.
